build_Cifar10_dataset: build a CIFAR-10 dataset builder that downloads and generates 32x32 color images with 10 class labels
build_Cifar100_dataset: build a CIFAR-100 dataset builder with 100 fine classes and 20 coarse superclasses
create_CifarInfo_config: create a CifarInfo configuration object specifying download URL, file paths, and label keys
run__load_data: run the _load_data function to parse binary CIFAR files into label and image tuples
review_Cifar10__split_generators: review the Cifar10._split_generators method that downloads data and defines train and test splits
